prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Creation: Move the sign in screen after pet creation and adoption so users build a pet before being asked to create or sign into an account. (why: Sign in currently converts at 72.9% early in the flow; letting users adopt first increases motivation before account creation.)
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Controls Guide Card: Redesign the home welcome screen into a split layout with clear visual cards showing how to interact with, hide, and summon the pet. (why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Live Desktop Companion Preview: Show an interactive animated pet preview on desktop background while waiting for engine generation to complete. (why: Home waiting screen has a median wait of 201s (mean 2336s) causing users to assume the app stalled or failed to launch.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Path Stage Selection: Rebuild the choice screen into a stage layout with clear cards comparing quick ready pets versus custom AI pet creation. (why: Choose path screen has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between available onboarding paths.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Best Practices Guidance: Add persistent photo quality tips and instructions on the upload photos screen for better pet rendering. (why: Users complain custom pets look wrong or fail to generate, contributing to dropoff during adoption.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background Wait Notification Switch: Enable background ready notifications and time estimates on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app. (why: Median waiting time is over 3 minutes with high variance, leading users to close the app early.)
6: [choose_path, redesign] Animated Story Intro Stage: Redesign the welcome story screen to feature an animated pet mascot with a step counter. (why: High mean time (514s) on path choice screen suggests users need clearer setup context from the very first screen.)
